prompt:
只重画左侧大盾的下半部外轮廓，人物和鬼面上半部保持。

用户要的是“外扩的弧形”，目前仍然像两边掐腰往内收。请做显著改动：
最重要的是盾靠人物身体的画面右侧那条银色长边：从上方尖端通向下部角根，中间一段要向画面右侧鼓出去，形成饱满的凸弧“）”，不能继续画成向盾心凹入的S形弯腰。端点大致保持，中段向外扩出约100像素（原图1254像素量级），让蓝色保护面随之变宽。这条边可以合理遮挡人物左侧一小部分衣摆，不要为了避让衣服而向内缩。
盾画面左侧的蓝色侧边也向左鼓出一条连续的大弧“（”，与右侧共同形成上宽、下腹也饱满的宽阔盾体，蓝面不能是瘦腰葫芦形。
盾最下方银色鬼角仍有立体厚度，但其根部要跟随宽盾腹展开，主体外缘要饱满外凸；只允许角尖内侧有小范围弯曲，不能让整个盾的下轮廓大幅向内凹。保留一个收尖角端即可，不增加新尖刺。
外扩弧线是这次唯一重点，要清晰明显，不能只磨圆一小块或微调颜色。鬼面、盾的斜向空间关系和两到三大甲面仍保留。银边宽度均匀，有正面和侧面，蓝色盾面占主体。
原人物头身比、脸、全黑胡须、蓝银重甲、青色鬼焰、右手和双脚不改，无武器。干净项目icon画风，大色块，少量明暗，暖米白方形背景，留够边距给扩宽的盾，不裁切。

initial_pass.prompt:
Precise LOCAL SHIELD CONTOUR revision of this exact blue ghost guard.
User's correction: the LOWER SHIELD EDGES should curve OUTWARD in broad expanding arcs, not pinch inward as in the input.

Redraw the lower half of the integrated ghost-face shield:
- Replace its inward-concave waist and inward-pulling side boundaries with FULL OUTWARD-CONVEX CURVES. Both sides of the lower shield body sweep outward from below the ghost jaw, widening the protective blue belly in a generous arc before gently turning toward the lower end.
- The outer silhouette should visibly BULGE AWAY FROM the shield centerline. Remove the deep crescent-shaped cut-in on the lower-left edge and the narrow inward S-shaped squeeze on the inner/right shield edge.
- More broad blue protective surface under the jaw, a fuller lower silhouette, continuous substantial body. Do not simply add a small spike outside the same concave outline.
- The lower SILVER GHOST HORN remains a THREE-DIMENSIONAL sculpted form echoing the top horn, with a thick root and curved taper; reorient its broad outer surface to follow the NEW outward-expanding lower arc. Its outermost contour is rounded-convex and expansive before ending in a restrained tip. Do not make a flat V border, thin sickle or deep inward hook.
- Silver framing follows the new convex body with consistent thickness, blue face remains dominant. Show broad silver front/side planes and a dark turned rim, not fine facets.
- Preserve the shield's oblique direction and ghost-face perspective: nearer side toward the body appears broader, far side foreshortened, upper edges slant with the existing shield. Do not flatten it front-on or turn it into a vertical rectangular door.
- Keep local design balanced around its own axis while respecting perspective. Integrated mask-to-shield and rear supporting arm remain credible.

Everything above the lower shield and the rest of the character stays in the same design: upper blue ghost mask/short silver horn, human face/all-dark beard/hair, blue heavy armor, cyan collar flame, pose, empty right fist, boots and background. Full-body composition, both feet visible, no new weapons or props.
Project icon style: strong clean dark outline, broad matte blue/navy/silver planes, few coherent light/shadow groups, no noise, excessive detail or gloss. Square plain warm ivory canvas, safe margins around the newly widened shield.
